correction.earlier_claim: The v20 optional engineering TrajectoryCredit-to-singleton mismatch was presented as a mandatory V0.3 binary choice: draft whole-credit B2 or reconsider comparison objects.
correction.corrected_claim: V0.3R's normative experiment concerns persistent update laws given regime-specific credit truth. TrajectoryCredit is explicitly an unselected engineering candidate, not a mandatory V0.3 scientific treatment. The candidate-induced choice is not established as a V0.3 completion prerequisite.

normative_evidence.fact: 08-V03R is explicitly not resynchronized and must not be the implementation authority. V0.3R studies Gamma_r_star -> legal persistent update hypotheses -> persistent state change -> future outcome, not runtime repair.
T and P have different truth sources; P truth comes only from persistent learner manifestations. Multiple manifestations in one episode are admitted and every manifested credit is retained.
The preregistered decision defect family must contain k and shape axes and report effect-by-k and effect-by-shape; one stratum cannot support global superiority.

Primitive is regime-blind, does not receive Gamma_star or T/P, and writes only the addresses resolved from regime-specific credited units plus permitted assistance. Evaluator truth is not unrestricted L0 content.
Every credited context has exactly one address plan and receipt; all scene edits enter one transaction.

D_Q contrasts FactualReturnWrite at L0, CounterfactualReturnWrite/DualReturnWrite at L2, LocalOracleRestore at L3 against their same-tier NoWriteRef. Process/controller retain inherited typed matrix; these are update-law comparisons, not the candidate diagnostic family.

Collateral eligibility is E(c) = scenes not consulting the declared credited site c and successful before update. It is quantified over the single-site credited domain and does not define an E(S) or per-site aggregation for simultaneous writes.
Plans all addresses, lowers row operations against one pre-state and commits a whole-scene transaction, with per-plan receipts.
Resolved B1 credit must equal the singleton (credited_site.address,), not merely contain the declared site.
Explicitly not a selected scientific family; TrajectoryCredit emits Episode and makes no inference about a particular cause/site.
Engineering invocation audit explicitly says scientific_algorithm_family_selected_or_frozen=false and no collection.
Dense measurement/grid and fresh identity do not independently approve a new whole-credit primary endpoint or a diagnostic algorithm family.

distinctions.installed_defect_k: Number of addressed decision contexts installed in the persistent defect family; not a scalar-parameter budget.
distinctions.manifested_credit_set: All actual regime-specific persistent manifestations on the trigger trajectory; not automatically every installed defect and not candidate predictions.
distinctions.candidate_predictions: Full native expansion of an optional diagnostic proposal, including incorrect/nonwriteable/residual predictions; not Gamma_star.
distinctions.scalar_edits: Per-context internal Q entries may exceed one. A credited DecisionAddress owns a row; several scalar edits in that row do not create several independent credited sites or seeds.
distinctions.inference_unit: Independent environment seed, not site, event, scenario or receipt.

confirmed_coverage_gap.statement: Original normative scope allows complete multi-manifestation credit while the existing scientific B2 entry point accepts only one resolved site. B1 whole-set support is present, but no source-bound interpretation or frozen rule was found in the cited normative layers that closes whole-update Collateral through the single-site B2 interface.
